title: Private themes: a theme can be offered only to the sites it belongs to

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-22: "I need a private / custom theme feature for the theme builder. I have a couple different themes for different sites, that won't go in the public system." Direction picked on the card: "Catalog first, then each theme".

detail: Before this, a hidden theme (RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS) was hidden from everyone: no site could be assigned one, a site that switched away could not switch back, any Space could save one, and nothing stopped a hidden id reaching /themes, the sitemap or llms.txt. Now lib/theme/site-style.ts holds the one audience catalog: the private set plus PRIVATE_THEME_SITES (the Space slugs each private theme is offered to). The old Network theme is assigned to The Group and its six chapters, the old Temple theme to Royal Temple, and Default to no one (it stays the read fallback, never offered). themesForSpace(slug) feeds the website editor's Theme tab, Change theme dialog, Pick your look, theme drafts and page theme, and the Identity and branding form, so a Space sees the public themes plus its own private ones. mayWearTheme is checked on every save: applyMegaTheme, updateSpaceProfile's siteTheme and a page's own theme in saveWebsiteStyle. lib/theme/private-themes.test.ts fails if a private id reaches SITE_THEMES, THEME_LIBRARY, share cards, the builder kit order, the create-a-space look step, the /themes showcase, the sitemap or llms.txt. No visible change for any live site. Not yet: the v3 builder's theme lens still lists the public themes only, and an admin view of the private catalog is the next row. Next: load Daniel's site themes from Claude Design handoffs, one PR per theme.
